status: E(Q) = Z*Q, proved. Rank <= 1: PARI 2.19 ellrank with certified cubic-field data (bnfcertify = 1), see certified_rank.gp. Index: Voutier-Yabuta height bounds in exact rational arithmetic give index <= 7 (height_certificate.py), and reduction certificates exclude every prime up to that bound (check_exact.py); Sage/mwrank saturation (eclib's own index bound 12, primes <= 11) independently gives index 1 (evidence/).
source_of_target: Best-Matschke unknown list (ec-data-S6 data/mwMordellUnknown.txt, commit c31a0f6)
bsd_check: h(Q) / (L'(1)/ellbsd) = 1.000... to 60 digits (consistent with Sha = 1; numerical, not a proof of BSD)

provenance.four_cover: Long's relative four-descent above c1 (882a0dac, proof=True): one locally soluble model class, label 5; reduced by search4.py (4-digit quadrics)
provenance.found_by: elkies4q.c (osculating box, quad precision), H = 2e12, VOL = 64, nominal second half [0.5, 1) of the discovered real component: point emitted after about 12 h on the winning VM core while the first half ran on a second core; not a completed search. Earlier attempts returned no point: elkies4.c at H = 1e10 (about 8 h), and PARI ellheegner terminated at an 8 h timeout.
provenance.calibration: log max|u| = 26.0094251931 = h_PAR/8 - 1.2350479112 (rounded; observed on this model only)

isogenous_curve.note: image of Q under the 3-isogeny (with the recorded model isomorphism); its PARI-normalized height numerically agrees with L'(1)/ellbsd, approximately 653.86735. This is consistent with Sha = 1 under BSD, not a proof about Sha.
